name: Justin Peck
summary: Master’s student in Mechanical Engineering and Engineering Management at CU Boulder, with experience in product design and manufacturing. Seeking an internship in Winter-Spring 2027 in mechanical engineering product design.

about.headline: Hi! I’m Justin.
bio: I’m a 23 year-old product design engineer from Los Gatos, California. I graduated from UC Berkeley, and am now attending CU Boulder for my Masters in Mechanical Engineering and Engineering Management.
I am passionate about Product Design and have recently completed Design Engineering internships at SRAM/Rockshox and Apple. I am interested in pursuing a career in tech or the bike industry.
Aside from engineering, I enjoy spending my time in the outdoors skiing, surfing, and cycling. I compete in professional level cross country mountain bike races around the world.

roles.title: Rear Shock Design Engineering Intern
bullets: Designed, prototyped, and tested several injection molded parts for future production rear shock airspring
Completed concept CAD and ran MATLAB simulations for adjustable compression/rebound hydraulic damper

roles.title: Front Derailleur Design Engineering Intern
bullets: Developed prototypes, molds, and fixtures using FEA optimization, generative design, and drawings in Creo
Redesigned production link for injection molding, achieving 51% lighter, 44% stiffer, and 10x less expensive part

roles.title: Watch Product Design Intern
bullets: Module-level design with assembly of 16 parts, determined datum structures and performed tolerance analysis to ensure proper fit and function across part distributions. DFM for CNC, die-cut, and IM components
Designed o-ring seal for optimal compression, stretch, and gland fill at MMC and LMC part tolerance conditions
PD for flexible printed circuit board, worked with EE and layout teams to define PCB outline, released IDX file
DRI for component in Watch Series 10, worked with vendors and completed Rev A drawing release process
Design of spring-loaded mechanisms for future architecture, kicked off CNC prototypes for user experience

roles.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
bullets: Internship project focused on the design of a carbon fiber full suspension mountain bike in 2D and 3D CAD
Hands on manufacturing experience, programmed and ran CNC mill to create molds for carbon fiber components

roles.title: Frame Team Lead
bullets: Led team of undergrads to design printed aluminum lugs for lugged carbon fiber downhill bike project
Created custom linkage design and machined components for steel full suspension mountain bike
Designed parametric welding and tube mitering jigs to fabricate custom geometry steel frames
